messages:
Iris: Quick QA on the new guided-tour pill that surfaces on first-run. Focus: copy, contrast, and whether the pill feels interruptive. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new-tour
Ben: Saw the preview. First thought: pill copy 'Welcome — Try a quick tour' is wordy. Suggest 'Take a quick tour' or just 'Quick tour'.
Katherine: Leaning 'Take a quick tour'  clearer call to action and not too terse. Also the close icon is quite small on mobile. Needs at least 44x44 tap target.
Omar: Accessibility flags: pill background color #E6F0FF with blue text #0A66CC is ~3.6:1 for 13px. Fails AA. If we keep tint, bump text weight or use #084B9A for the link.
Samir: Repro'd keyboard flow: when pressing Tab from top nav the pill receives focus but focus ring is subtle. Proposed CSS:

.guided-pill:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(10,102,204,0.18); outline: none; }
.guided-close { width: 44px; height: 44px; }

That should fix both visibility and target size.

Iris: Good. Also thinking about timing: should the pill show immediately or after user opens Console once? We had complaints it competes with first task flows.

Ben: Maybe delay by 5s or show only when the workspace is empty (no API keys, no projects). Conditioned display feels less interruptive.

Katherine: Copy change approved: 'Take a quick tour' with accessible label 'Guided tour: overview of Console features'. Add alt text for the pill icon.
Omar: I'll test color variant with #084B9A and semi-bold 600. Will run Axe and post results.

ux-bot: Deploy preview up: https://deploy-preview.example.com/guided-pill (branch: guided-pill-a11y)

Samir: Checked preview  contrast with #084B9A hits 4.7:1 at 13px semibold. Tap target fixed. Only remaining is motion: the pill fades in from top; reduce duration to 160ms for less jank on low-end devices.

Iris: Great catch. Ben/Katherine can we land the copy + delay logic and merge after the motion tweak? Also track event 'guided_pill_shown' and 'guided_pill_dismissed'.

Ben: On it. I'll open a PR tomorrow and ping #eng-frontend. Thanks folks :raised_hands:
